caption: The drawing depicts an ornate, angled bookstand or lectern designed in a classical style, featuring decorative elements such as foliage, floral patterns, and scrollwork. The object is primarily colored in soft beige, green, pink, and red hues, with red drapery-like elements and green garlands adorning the side. The front face of the stand displays what appears to be a page or plaque with lines of text and a rectangular illustration above the text, showing three human figures standing on a grassy area with trees in the background. The structure has an angled surface to support a book, with elaborate carved details along the side, including a prominent curled design at the base and accents of pink flowers. The composition centers the lectern against a plain off-white background, and the number "19" appears in the lower left corner.
title: Plate 19: Reading Stand, Chimayo: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
